The FAQ now says "Reporting traces his signing to 'Caroline,' a song he posted on TikTok in 2022 that brought label emails." The remaining limit is narrowed to what is unreported: how his management team was assembled. Claims C28d and C28g revised; C28i, C28j, C03b and C03d added (S04, S07, S08, S18).

FAQ: "which produces charity dinners" and "saying his father 'devotes his life to fight AIDS.'" The father's team role is now a separate, dated sentence ("NYLON reported in April 2026...") placed after the documented TikTok route, not as the clause after the allegation.
